data.long_meaning: The name Vandana is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vandana’ meaning ‘an offering, homage, tribute’. This name is used to honor and pay respect to deities, elders, and loved ones. In Hindu mythology, Vandana is also the name of a goddess, symbolizing devotion and dedication. The name Vandana carries the meaning “Offering, Homage, Tribute” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vandana usually hope their child will grow to embody offering, homage, tribute and live with faith, good character and purpose.
